description: Save one school's policy after the server checks it. Every source is a capture_file that playlist_policy_open named and a quote of 300 characters or fewer copied verbatim from that capture's cleaned text; the quote check is exact, with no fuzzy matching. The server also checks that every course code is one of the school's CourseShelf learning units, every award_title appears in the award_types section, and every min_credits is a positive number. It never alters the policy. It returns policy_id, status, and every error in plain words: a policy with errors is saved as rejected, so correct it and save again.
